title: Why VR is finally ready to replace your monitor

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: VR finally offers immersive, full-screen interaction without the clutter of multiple monitors or desk space. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But VR still suffers from latency, motion sickness, and lacks the precision of a high-resolution monitor for detailed work. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Modern VR headsets like the Meta Quest 3 use foveated rendering and 120Hz refresh rates, making them viable for professional use. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even with that, VR can't match the ergonomics and multi-tasking capabilities of a dual-monitor setup for developers and designers. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: VR is the future—once the tech matures, it will replace monitors as the primary interface for work and creativity. (4 sec)
